docTitle: Nine Men's Morris | Iziqwenga ezi-9 kunye nezi-12 (Morabaraba)
onlinePrepText: Iseva ekwi-intanethi ayikakulungeli okwangoku. Nje ukuba iqhagamshelwe, uya kukwazi ukudlala apha. Amaqhosha kunye nokufakwayo kukhutshaziwe okwangoku.

contactPrep: Indawo yoqhagamshelwano ayikakulungeli. Nje ukuba iqhagamshelwe, uya kukwazi ukuthumela ukusuka apha. Amagalelo kunye neqhosha lokuthumela zikhutshaziwe okwangoku.
myInqPrep: Nje ukuba indawo iqhagamshelwe, uya kukwazi ukubona imiyalezo yakho ethunyelweyo kunye neempendulo apha.
r1c: Cofa indawo engenanto ukuze ubeke isiqwenga. Umnyama nomhlophe bayatshintshana ngokubeka de zonke iziqwenga zibe ebhodini. Umnyama uhamba kuqala.
r1c2: Indlela yokudlala: cofa nje indawo engenanto apho utolo olumhlophe luya khona.
r2c: Xa iziqwenga zakho ezintathu zimi kumgca, oko kukuthi itshili, kwaye ungathatha enye yeziqwenga zomchasi wakho.
r2c2: Indlela yokudlala: emva kokwenza itshili, cofa isiqwenga somchasi ofuna ukusithatha.
r2c3: Isiqwenga esingaphakathi kwetshili asinakuthathwa, ngaphandle kokuba zonke iziqwenga zomchasi wakho zikwitshili; emva koko ungathatha esinye kwitshili.
r3t: ③ Emva koko hambisa iziqwenga zakho
r3c: Nje ukuba zonke iziqwenga zibekiwe, tyibiliza isiqwenga ecaleni komgca ukuya kwindawo engenanto ekufutshane. Iziqwenga ezinokushukuma zifumana isangqa esinombala obonakala ngasemva. Cofa isiqwenga kwaye iindawo ezisiya kuzo ziyakhanya.
r3c2: Indlela yokudlala: cofa isiqwenga ofuna ukusishukumisa, uze ucofe indawo ekufutshane ekhanyayo.
r4c: Xa usele neziqwenga ezintathu kuphela, ungabhabha uye nakweyiphi na indawo engenanto, nokuba akukho mgca uzidibanisayo.
r4c2: Indlela yokudlala: cofa isiqwenga sakho, uze ucofe indawo engenanto ofuna ukubhabha kuyo.
r5c: Uyaphumelela ngokunciphisa utshaba lwakho lube ziingceba ezibini, okanye ngokuzishiya zingenantshukumo esemthethweni.
r6c: Umdlali ngamnye uneeziqwenga ezili-12 kwaye kongezwa imigca emine ethe tyaba. Ungahamba nge-diagonal, kwaye ezintathu ezilandelelanayo kwi-diagonal nazo zenza i-mill.
r6c2: Indlela yokudlala: iintshukumo ezithe tyaba zisebenza ngendlela efanayo — cofa iqhekeza, uze ucofe indawo oya kuyo.
r6c3: Ukuba ibhodi izalisa ngokupheleleyo ngexesha lesigaba sokubeka, umdlali oza kuhamba akanakushukuma aze aphulukane.
r7c: Umdlalo utsalwa ngokuzenzekelayo nakweyiphi na imeko engezantsi. Akukho qhosha lokubonelela ngomdlalo.
r7c2: · Indawo efanayo yebhodi enomdlali omnye oshukumayo yenzeka kathathu
r7c3: · Iintshukumo ezingama-50 (bobabini abadlali bedibene) zidlula ngaphandle kwesixhobo sokugaya
r7c4: · Inguqulelo yeziqwenga ezili-12 kuphela: ngelixa umdlali eneenxalenye ezintathu, iintshukumo ezili-10 (ezidibeneyo) zidlula kungekho mntu ubambayo
r8c: Nokuba intshukumo enye yenza iifektri ezimbini ngaxeshanye, usathatha iqhekeza elinye kuphela.
r8c2: Inguqulelo yeziqwenga ezili-9: ungaphula ifektri uze uyivale kwakhona kwintshukumo yakho elandelayo; ngalo lonke ixesha uyivala, uthatha iqhekeza.
r8c3: Inguqulelo yeziqwenga ezili-12: ifektri oyiphulileyo ayinakwenziwa kwakhona kwintshukumo yakho elandelayo; linda intshukumo enye. Iintshukumo ezingakhi ifektri zilungile.
r8c4: Imidlalo ekwi-intanethi ineenyathelo ezintathu: Isiqhelo yimizuzwana engama-30 ngentshukumo nganye, Ukucotha yimizuzu emi-2, kunye noLetha ziiyure ezingama-24. Kwimidlalo yeSlow and Letter, intshukumo idlalwa ngokuzenzekelayo xa ixesha liphelile.

titlesPrep: Izihloko ziya kuvela xa iseva ekwi-intanethi iqhagamshelwe. Amagama kunye neemeko zezihloko ozifumanayo ziya kuboniswa kanye njengoko iseva izibuyisela. Ayikakulungeli okwangoku.
